senses.gloss:
कोणः [कुण्-करणे घञ् कर्त्तरि अच् वा Tv.]
—1 A corner, an angle (of anything); भयेन कोणे क्वचन स्थितस्य
 Vikr. 1. 99; युक्तमेतन्न तु पुनः कोणं नयनपद्मयोः Bv. 2. 173.
—2 An intermediate point of the compass.
—3 The bow of a lute; a fiddle-stick.
—4 The sharp edge of a sword or weapon.
—5 A stick, staff, club.
—6 A drum-stick; … कोणैर्भेर्यो निजघ्निरे Bk. 14. 2.
—7 N. of the planet Mars.
—8 N. of the planet Saturn.
—9 A sort of musical instrument [cf. Gr. gonia].
.━{@Comp.@}: कोणाघातः, कोणकुणः, कोणपारावतम्, कोणवादिन्, कोणवृत्तम्, कोणशङ्कुः

कोणः + -आघातः striking of drums, tabors &c., used in the sense of ‘a mingled sound of various musical instruments’
[]
; कोणाघातेषु गर्जत्प्रलयधनघटान्योन्यसंघट्टचण्डः
 Ve. 1. 22. (It is thus defined by Bharata:− ढक्काशतसहस्राणि भेरीशतशतानि
 च । एकदा यत्र हन्यन्ते कोणाघातः स उच्यते ॥).
कोणः + -कुणः, -पारावतम् (see कपोतपालिका) A dove-cot or doveridge, a bug.
कोणः + -कुणः, -पारावतम् (see कपोतपालिका) A dove-cot or doveridge, a bug.
कोणः + -वादिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.

कोणः + -वृत्तम् a vertical circle extending from north-east to south-west
 or from north-west to south-east.
कोणः + -शङ्कुः the sinus of the height of the sun.

कोणाकोणि^1 ind. From angle to angle, corner-wise, diagonally.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170124. note: Must end in short 'i' acc. to Pan. 5.4.127 referenced by PWG and MW..
कोणि a. Having a crooked hand.
